seed: Shannon Byrne Susko, Circle post Foundation Year: Q-4 and worksheet Build Up 3-5 Differentiators (prerequisite).

slides.title: Is your Core Customer still right?
slides.support: In Metronome: open War Room. Read your Core Customer aloud.
body: Is this still the customer you most want more of?
Are their three needs still right, in the same order?
What did the year teach you about them?
notes: Choosing one Core Customer and ranking their three needs was the Q2 work. If it is missing, keep going and mark the result draft.
Change only what the evidence changes. The differentiators must serve these needs.
slides.headline: Is your Core Customer still right?

slides.title: Is your 3HAG line agreed?
slides.support: In Metronome: open War Room. Put your Attribution Map on the screen.
body: Read the line: where you will lead, what you will maintain and what you will let drop.
Has anything changed since you drew it?
Agree on the line now, for your new 3‑year date. You build your differentiators from it.
notes: Drawing the 3HAG line was the Q3 work. The differentiators need the whole line agreed before they start.
If the line is not agreed or the competitors are not scored, keep going and mark the result draft.
slides.headline: Is your 3HAG line agreed?
